bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address}). The device will be provisioned when the integration starts. Leave the OOB key empty for No OOB provisioning.

reset_help.description: {name} ({address}) is already part of a Bluetooth Mesh network. Before continuing, completely close the Steinel app and any other Bluetooth app connected to the light. Switch the light's mains power off briefly, switch it back on, and then submit this form immediately. The integration will use the short startup window to reset and provision the light automatically. If setup does not succeed, repeat these steps and reload the integration entry.
reset_help.title: Prepare light for Mesh reset

data.restore_brightness: Restore remembered brightness after turning on

reset_failed.title: Mesh reset failed for {name}
reset_failed.description: Close the STEINEL app and every other Bluetooth client completely. Briefly disconnect the lamp from mains power, restore power, and immediately reload the integration entry. The reset is accepted only during a short startup window.
